# AtCoder Library

The vendored convolution headers come from [AtCoder Library](https://github.com/atcoder/ac-library),
release v1.6, commit `864245a00b00dd008d1abfdc239618fdb7d139da`.
The headers retain their CC0 1.0 Universal license in [LICENSE](LICENSE).
`score_convolution.hpp` combines modular convolution results using checked unsigned CRT.
